scope: AI-only independent read-only audit of all hold-editorial decisions for source ordinals 3012–3551. This report is evidence for editorial adjudication, not human review or approval.
method: Verified 540 unique ordinal/source rows across nine 60-row decision files and exact sourceId/phrase identity for every held occurrence.
Read each held phrase in its exact source sentence and guide meaning, applying Golden SOP criteria for complete target, natural reusable English, meaning, grammar, register and one canonical owner.

Compared the four clear same-sense matches against live canonical meanings and regex patterns. Treated detector-only matches with differing senses (3142, 3308, 3394) as separate candidates rather than aliases.
Classified all 205 held rows exactly once; candidate and owner-gap findings require editorial adjudication and do not authorize lesson selection.

priorityFindings.finding: Four clear false holds match their live canonical owners in full-source detector and reviewed meaning: 1114, 999, 1263, 242 respectively.

Canonical detectors incidentally match, but the source meanings differ: immediate vs simultaneous at once; unpredictable life vs socially scripted conduct; casual acquisition vs informal skill-learning. Do not auto-alias.
Additional possible teachable imagery, collocation or phrasal-verb targets; each needs a concise target and owner/sense review.
Conventional source variants blocked by narrow owner patterns; compare meaning then widen owner detector/examples before duplicating lessons.
Representative supported holds: source usage or wording is not yet natural/complete for the desired idiomatic sense.
